title: 第56章 指向性占卜

第56章 指向性占卜-《我发现了世界BUG》

下一章

看着徐峰的“日记”，林舒人傻了。

想过你小子藏得深，没想到你藏得那么深啊！

2010年，你就已经开始研究仪轨了？？

那时候你才多少岁？

15？16？

卧槽，还真是叛逆期！

不过......从16岁到32岁，整整16年，你都没被你爹发现？

还是说其实他早就发现了，只是看破不说破？

----但这都不重要了。

无论徐峰从徐长顺那里偷学了什么、又自学、研究出了什么，至少，他交给自己的东西，是实实在在的。

一路上，林舒都在研究着徐峰的日记，直到回到戒备森严的招待所里，又花了一个多小时，林舒才读完了整本日记。

在这本日记中，徐峰确实记录了自己在“蓍龟占卜术”研究中的重要突破。

但更多的，是别的东西。

......

“2010年10月12日，晴。今天我的仪轨成功了。老子不行儿子上，我早就看出来我爸那套是行不通的了。长江后浪推前浪，前浪拍死在沙滩上......”

“2010年12月5日，阴。这个仪轨就他么只能看到一个画面吗？怎么无论我做什么，最终都是死在棺材里。不是，我为什么会死在棺材里啊？？活埋吗？让我查出是谁干的，我把你撕了！”

“2011年4月5日，晴。对照试验法很有用，没想到学校里教的东西还能用在这里，我看到的画面变得更清晰了，但好像也只是变清晰了而已，我还是死在棺材里。以后随身带点可乐饼干，这样不用被饿死。”

“2014年9月1日，雨。我爸好像偷看了我的日记。老头子真的是.....他把所有东西都锁起来了，房间也不让我进了，我得想想办法......”

“2017年11月2日，阴。实验有了重大突破，这次终于不是死在棺材里了，有人救了我，但没救活。我看不清楚他的脸，我不知道他是谁，很陌生。”

“2018年2月16日，阴。还是没搞懂我看到的那个人是谁，但至少，我今天终于确定了引发这种变化的核心流程。看来，蓍龟占卜术确实不仅仅能看到死亡，它与古书流传中的描述是一致的，应该能够对任何特定事件进行占卜，但我不知道应该怎样将需要占卜的特定事件表达到仪轨中去。”

“2020年10月12日，晴。对仪轨的研究已经持续了整整十年，今天就是满10年的日子了，本来以为我的日记应该会写满一大堆本子，结果年纪大了，反而不爱写日记了。这几天都在整理过去留下的记录，才发现十年蹉跎，收获寥寥。似乎也只有蓍龟占卜一种仪轨，我是走在了父亲前面的。但归根结底，我还是踩在了他的肩膀上。”

“2024年10月12日，晴。蓍龟占卜术已经被开发到了极限。并不是仪轨的极限，而是我的极限。人力有时尽，我可能需要向外寻求其他的帮助了。真正看到那些画面之后，我才意识到为什么父亲不让我接触仪轨，但现在，似乎已经来不及了。”

“2026年1月6日，阴。占卜术变得更灵活了，但还是不明白我看到的那个人到底是谁。我在考虑要不要跟父亲坦白。三十而立，我也应该可以做出自己的选择了吧？”

Looking at Xu Feng's "diary", Lin Shuren was dumbfounded.

I thought you could hide it so deeply, but I didn’t expect you to hide it so deeply!

In 2010, you started studying rituals??

How old were you then?

15? 16?

Damn, this is really a rebellious period!

But...from the age of 16 to the age of 32, for 16 years, you were not discovered by your father?

Or is it that he actually discovered it a long time ago but just saw through it without revealing it?

----But that doesn't matter anymore.

No matter what Xu Feng secretly learned from Xu Changshun, or what he learned and researched on his own, at least what he gave to him was real.

Along the way, Lin Shu studied Xu Feng's diary. It was not until he returned to the heavily guarded guest house that it took more than an hour for Lin Shu to read the entire diary.

In this diary, Xu Feng indeed recorded his important breakthroughs in the research of "Yarrow Turtle Divination".

But more often than not, it’s something else.

...

"October 12, 2010, sunny. My ritual was successful today. If I can't do it, my son can do it. I have long seen that my father's method will not work. The waves behind the Yangtze River push the waves in front, and the waves in front hit him to death on the beach..."

"December 5, 2010, Yin. Can they only see one scene in this ritual? No matter what I do, I end up dying in a coffin. No, why do I die in a coffin? Buried alive? Let me find out who did it, and I will tear you apart!"

"April 5, 2011, Qing. The controlled experiment method is very useful. I didn't expect that the things taught in school can be used here. The picture I saw became clearer, but it seemed that it only became clearer. I still died in the coffin. From now on, I will carry some Coca-Cola biscuits with me so that I don't have to starve to death."

"September 1, 2014, Yu. My dad seemed to have peeked into my diary. The old man really... He locked everything up and wouldn't let me in the room. I have to think of a way..."

"November 2, 2017, Yin. The experiment made a major breakthrough. This time I finally didn't die in a coffin. Someone saved me, but he didn't survive. I couldn't see his face clearly. I didn't know who he was. He was very strange."

"February 16, 2018, Yin. I still don't understand who the person I saw is, but at least today, I finally determined the core process that caused this change. It seems that the turtle divination can indeed not only see death. It is consistent with the description in the ancient books. It should be able to divination any specific event, but I don't know how to express the specific event that requires divination into the ritual."

"October 12, 2020, Qing. The research on rituals has lasted for a full ten years. Today is the 10th anniversary. I originally thought that my diary would fill a lot of notebooks, but as I got older, I didn't like to write.I have been sorting out the records I left in the past few days, only to realize that I have been wasted for ten years and have achieved very little.It seems that there is only one ritual of divination, but in the final analysis, I still stand on his shoulders."

"October 12, 2024, Qing. The turtle divination technique has been developed to the limit. It is not the limit of the ritual, but my limit. Sometimes manpower is exhausted, and I may need to seek other help from the outside. Only after I really saw those scenes did I realize why my father did not let me get in touch with the ritual, but now, it seems that it is too late."

"January 6, 2026, Yin. Divination has become more flexible, but I still don't understand who the person I saw is. I'm thinking about whether to confess to my father. At thirty, I should be able to make my own choices, right?"
